Let $(AB)$ be a [[line]] passing through points $A,B$. Half-line $[AB)$ starts at point $A$, passes through and extend beyond point $B$.

Formally,

$$
\exists f:
\begin{cases}
f\bigl((AB)\bigr)=\mathbb{R} \\
f\bigl([AB)\bigr)=[0, \infty),\, f(A)=0, f(B) >0.
\end{cases}
$$

<ref>{{#cite:Q2300}}</ref>
